recap.text: Ruby is a child of Hump Town who survived a gnome bombing. Flint says she is destined for Weird Shit Alley. As a changeling, she has compression sickness, leaving her sterile with no arms and a sunken head in her default form.

Ruby is a changeling orphan with compression sickness, no arms, and a sunken head. Mordecai hires her as one of six room attendants in the court's personal space and pays her from supply money. Carl sees a game controller split into halves and propped on the floor with a small pillow.

beats.headline: One of the children who lived
beats.text: Subject is a child of Hump Town. Her village was bombed by the gnomes, the dromedarians took in what was left, and not many of the children lived. She did. Flint says she is destined to spend her life in Weird Shit Alley.
beats.gist: Ruby is a child of Hump Town who survived a gnome bombing.

beats.headline: Compression sickness
beats.text: Subject is a changeling, and she has compression sickness: in her default form she has no arms and her head is sunken. One birth in four now arrives this way, and the ones born with it are sterile. I note it because nobody else in the building will.
beats.gist: Ruby is a sterile changeling child with no arms and a sunken head from compression sickness.

beats.headline: One of six attendants
beats.text: Subject is a changeling orphan with compression sickness, met on the fifth floor: in human form, no arms and a sunken head. She is now employed as a room attendant in the court's personal space, one of six hired by Mordecai without mentioning it to the court and paid for out of its supply money. The game console has a new controller, split into left and right halves and propped on the floor at forty-five degrees with a small pillow in front of it. Carl works out who it is for. Mordecai stands by his decision.
beats.gist: Ruby is a changeling orphan with compression sickness, no arms, and a sunken head.
